input.channels: 22 EEG only; EOG used only in official artifact annotation
input.run_filter: 8-30 Hz fourth-order Butterworth IIR, forward-backward zero-phase

fft_features.feature: log10 integrated PSD within band per EEG channel; fixed 88 dimensions

normalization: StandardScaler fit on source-subject training trials only
primary_split: 9-fold leave-one-subject-out; both target sessions held out
test_population: same expert-clean held-out subject trials for both training policies
primary_metric: per-held-out-subject balanced accuracy on fixed clean test population
contrasts: WelchPSD88 minus CSP4 under clean training
Fusion92 minus CSP4 under clean training
all-trial training minus clean training for each fixed model on identical clean test IDs
inference: descriptive paired differences and percentile bootstrap 95% intervals, exploratory; no claim of superiority from post-hoc winner
hypotheses: Fourier-derived bandpower may complement CSP spatial variance under subject shift, but could also underperform.
Including expert-flagged source training trials may change clean-target accuracy; direction is unknown.
limitations: This is a protocol frozen after inspecting P2 baseline results, not an independent preregistration.
Official expert artifact flags are not an automatic artifact-removal algorithm.
Zero-phase filtering and expert-clean target testing are offline-only conditions.
No target EEG or labels are used to fit CSP, scaling, or classifier.
